title: The $F$-signature Function on the Big Cone
summary: We define and study the $F$-signature of big divisors on projective varieties in positive characteristics. For a normal projective variety $X$, we show that the $F$-signature function defines a continuous function on the big cone of $X$, extending our previous results on the ample cone. By studying the the Frobenius-alpha invariant on the big cone, we prove that the positivity of the $F$-signature of any big $\mathbb{R}$-divisor on $X$ is equivalent to the global $F$-regularity of $X$.
